justification: Both surfaces depict human figures and A has an ornate headdress and staff-like elements while B includes concentric circles/discs, but nothing beyond the universal category of "human figure" and "circle" is shared. A shows a single large, detailed, elaborately costumed personage in profile with headdress, ornaments and a subsidiary crouching figure, rendered in relatively naturalistic modelled relief; B shows scattered tiny stick-figures, animals and abstract signs distributed loosely over the surface in a wholly schematic linear manner with no dominant figure or compositional frame.
